summary: Independent testing of Phase 6 Commission module (RBAC matrix + closing lifecycle + role-specific frontend). Wrote pytest suite test_commission_rbac_lifecycle.py (19 tests, all PASS) and executed Playwright UI checks for Super Admin, Accounting and Sales roles. All acceptance criteria in the review request are met. Test data cleaned up (periods 2099-01, 2099-02, RBACTEST schemes).
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate GET/PUT commission settings endpoints exist: /commission-settings (line ~2679) and /commissions/settings (line ~2967). Both permit commission.manage view. Consider deprecating /commission-settings to avoid ambiguity; PUT /commission-settings still allows commission.manage (Accounting) to overwrite the entire commission settings block, potentially bypassing the Super-Admin-only guard on /commissions/settings. Recommend guarding /commission-settings PUT with require_role('super_admin') too, or removing it.
server.py is > 3300 lines; consider splitting Phase 6 commission block into its own router module for maintainability.
commission_lines/commission_items collections are only cleaned on recalc; deleting a closing directly (no endpoint) leaves orphan items/lines. Fine for now since no delete endpoint is exposed.
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Super Admin, Sales A, Accounting).
seed_data_creation: Created & then deleted: commission closings for periods 2099-01, 2099-02; scheme RBACTEST-1/RBACTEST-1b (created+deleted inside test). No residue in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 Commission fully verified. RBAC matrix: Sales->403 on all mgmt endpoints incl. GET /commissions/schemes; Accounting can GET schemes/settings/closings, calculate/close/adjust/payment, but 403 on POST/PUT/DELETE schemes, PUT settings, POST reopen; Super Admin full. Lifecycle OPEN->REVIEW->APPROVED->CLOSED->PAID enforced with locking (recalc 400 after CLOSED, adjustment 400 after CLOSED/PAID) and Super-Admin-only reopen. Frontend role branching correct (Sales sees my-commission-page + 4 cards + previous table; Accounting sees closings/schemes tabs but no Settings tab and no scheme create btn; Super Admin sees everything incl. dialogs). Auto-cleanup fixture wipes 2099-* periods and RBACTEST schemes.
